title: Stop a SidePanel Chat task
description: Development only: press Stop task on the Chat task's message, as the person does (the task ends cancelled; its run, if any, is stopped by the same owner). For ending a benchmark case at its time limit.
guidance: Only when the person explicitly asked you to benchmark or live-check the Chat, and only while the person's grant is on (SidePanel Settings, development builds, one hour; no capability can turn it on): without it every call is refused with POLICY_DENIED (CHAT_AGENT_ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED). Refused with TARGET_NOT_FOUND (CHAT_TASK_NOT_FOUND) when the open conversation has no such task of the Chat (an outside agent's mirrored task is stopped by its own agent). Requires an idempotency key.

sessionId.description: The Chat task (its sessionId from dsagent.development.chat.state or .transcript).

stopped.description: Stop task was pressed; follow the task to its cancelled end.
